title: Non-blocking finding from PR #338's review (frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups)
description: Tracked follow-up for a non-blocking finding raised in pr-reviewer's review of PR #338 (frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups) -- doesn't block the accept (PR #338's own decisions entry already explicitly scoped this out, with reasonable rationale), but is worth fixing so it isn't lost once PR #338 merges and the review comment disappears from view.

checklist.step: `AddPositionDialog.tsx`'s `<Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} fullWidth maxWidth="sm">` (line 153) still has the identical Escape-key/backdrop-click dismissal gap `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx` had before PR #338: only the dialog's own Cancel/Confirm buttons are guarded by `disabled={addPosition.isPending}` (lines 224/227), but MUI's `Dialog` fires `onClose` on Escape and backdrop click regardless of any button's disabled state, so a user can dismiss the dialog mid-`useAddPosition()` mutation. PR #338 fixed this exact pattern in `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx` via a `handleDialogClose` wrapper that no-ops while the mutation is pending (see that PR's diff and its own `decisions` entry, which explicitly deferred fixing `AddPositionDialog.tsx` in the same PR as a scope call, not an oversight). Apply the same guard here -- either a local `handleDialogClose` wrapper mirroring `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx`'s, or, now that this pattern exists in two dialogs, consider extracting a small shared helper/hook (e.g. `useGuardedDialogClose(onClose, isPending)`) if that's judged worth the abstraction at this point.
